fact: The BCV's 2024 behavioural supervision report records 245 complaints, 3,267,665 escudos refunded (up 88% on 2023) mainly for unauthorised movements through payment cards and internet banking platforms, and five inspections in 2024.
title: Consumidores financeiros ressarcidos em mais de 3,2 milhões de escudos em 2024 - BCV
